Notes to the consolidated financial statements
for the year ended 31st March 2026
(All amounts in ₹ lakhs, unless stated otherwise)

43  Leases

The Group as a lessee

The Group's leases primarily consists of leases for land. Generally, the contracts are made for fixed period and does not have a purchase
option at the end of lease term. The Group’s obligations under its leases are secured by the lessor’s title to the leased assets. The Group
applies the ‘short-term lease’ recognition exemptions for these leases with lease terms of 12 months or less.

(i)   Amount recognised in the Balance sheet
